**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Make recoverable ledger states retryable**

Because the preflight check skips any `findBySourceKey` hit, inserting a `pending` row before the GitHub write makes a row permanently skipped if the process exits after this insert but before `markImported` (and rows later marked `failed` have the same problem). A retry of the same spreadsheet then returns `skipped` without creating the issue/milestone/project item, so only completed imports should satisfy the idempotency check or pending/failed rows should have a recovery path.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include evidence fields in report hashes**

This hash now drops `evidenceIds` and `schemaVersion` along with `generatedAt`. If a report is regenerated to correct or add evidence IDs while keeping the same metrics and text, `insert()` produces the same `report_id` and `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` classifies the corrected report as a duplicate, so the stored/audited evidence remains stale. If the goal is only to ignore clock jitter, keep all payload fields except `period.generatedAt` in the stable input.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep traceability IDs in their namespace**

With `serverDir` added wholesale to `devopsCorpus`, server files/tests that cite PrjOps IDs now satisfy DevOps IDs by plain string match. Checked example: `packages/server/src/http/routes/xlsxImport.ts` and `packages/server/tests/xlsxImportRoutes.test.ts` cite `SPEC-INT-063` for Excel import, while `packages/traceability/spec-ids/devops.json` and ADR-0002 define DevOps `SPEC-INT-063` as the Claude Code code-fix requirement; the matrix can now go green for the wrong spec. Please namespace or filter server references instead of sharing the whole corpus.
